briefs:
Somebody stayed at {company} in {city} under a name that was not theirs, and I am paying to find out which one. The answer is in {file}.

Copy it and bring it to me. The front desk does not need to know anyone looked.

A man I am divorcing says he was at a conference in {city}. {company} can tell me whether he had company. It is in {file}.

Copy it. My lawyer will do the rest.

titles: A stay that did not happen
briefs:
I spent two nights at {company} in {city} that I would like never to have spent. It is all in {file}.

Delete it. Do not read it first. Their security is {tier}.

{company} in {city} keeps better records than its guests would like. One of those records is {file}, and one of those guests is paying me.

Delete it. Hotels lose bookings all the time.

{company} in {city} keeps its {records} on the server. Booking {key} needs to say "{value}" before the morning shift looks at it.

Change the {column} and leave the rest alone.

I have a guest arriving at {company} who must not be turned away at the desk. Booking {key} in their {records} currently says otherwise.

Set the {column} to "{value}". Their security is {tier}.

{company} in {city} is sitting on something it has not broadcast. I want to see {file} before the rest of the country does.

Copy it. Their security is {tier}.

A reporter at {company} has been asking about me for weeks. I would like to know how much they have. It will be in {file}.

Copy it out of the {city} newsroom. Leave the original, or they will know to hurry.

{company} has a file called {file}, and my name is in it. If it goes out, I am finished in {city}.

Delete it before anyone in the newsroom makes another copy.

There is an item sitting at {company} that goes out on Friday unless it cannot be found. It is in {file}.

Delete it. Their security is {tier}. Newsrooms are careless about everything but deadlines.

The {records} at {company} in {city} decides what goes out and when. Slot {key} should read "{value}".

Change the {column}. By the time anyone asks who moved it, it will have aired.

I have bought time on {company} and been given a slot nobody will be awake for. Their {records} has it as {key}.

Change the {column} to "{value}". They will air what the table tells them to.

{company} in {city} tested something for a firm I have money in, and the summary they published is too tidy. The working is in {file}.

Copy it for me. I would like to know what I own.

{company} in {city} has finished a piece of testing that two firms are waiting on. One of them has paid me to see it first. The file is {file}.

Copy it. An hour's head start is worth a great deal in my trade.

{company} ran a test that came back the wrong way for my client. The result is in {file} and it has not been sent out yet.

Delete it. A laboratory loses things now and then. Their security is {tier}.

A sample went through {company} that should never have been sent. The paperwork is in {file}.

Delete it and the sample is just a jar with a number on it. Do not copy it first.

{company} in {city} keeps a table of {records}. Sample {key} came back with a {column} my client cannot live with.

Make it read "{value}". Nothing else in the table needs to change.

Somebody is going to lose a contract over sample {key} at {company}. The {column} in their {records} table is the whole of the case against them.

Make it read "{value}". Their security is {tier}.

{company} in {city} decided something last month in a room with the door shut. What they had in front of them is in {file}.

Copy it. People who live there have a right to read it, and I intend to help them.

{company} in {city} is choosing a contractor this month. What the others have offered is in {file}, and my own bid is not yet written.

Copy it. I would like to know what I have to beat.

There is a file at {company} called {file}. As long as it exists, a building of mine in {city} does not.

Delete it. Councils lose paperwork every day of the week.

Forty people signed something and sent it to {company}, and it is now a file called {file} that stands between me and a car park.

Delete it. Their security is {tier}.

{company} in {city} keeps its {records} on the server. Application {key} has been given the wrong {column}.

It should say "{value}". Their security is {tier}, which for a council is saying something.

Somebody at {company} has sat on application {key} for a year. I have stopped waiting.

In their {records}, set its {column} to "{value}". Nobody at a council questions a decision that is already in the system.

{company} in {city} looks after money for people who would rather not be asked about it. One of them owes me. The proof is in {file}.

Copy it and bring it back. Their security is {tier}, as you would expect.

A partner of mine banks at {company} in {city} and has been telling me the money is all still there. {file} will tell me the truth.

Copy it. Go carefully: a private bank does not forgive visitors.

{company} holds a file called {file} that ties me to money I have told three governments I do not have.

Delete it. Be careful in there: a private bank in {city} watches its own door.

{company} keeps notes on its clients, and what they have written about me is in {file}. It reads like a confession I did not make.

Delete it before their compliance people open it. Their security is {tier}.

The {records} table at {company} in {city} has account {key} down wrongly, and while it does, nothing moves.

Make the {column} read "{value}". Then leave quietly.

Account {key} at {company} in {city} has been marked in a way that stops it being used. The owner cannot wait for the bank to change its mind.

Set the {column} to "{value}". One row. Then go.

{company} in {city} is putting something under the hammer that I mean to buy. I would bid better if I had read {file} first.

Copy it. Nobody in the saleroom needs to know I have seen it.

There is a sale coming up at {company}, and I am told somebody means to outbid me whatever it costs. Their name will be in {file}.

Copy it from the {city} office. Their security is {tier}.

{company} has a file called {file} that says where a piece of mine has been. I would rather it had been nowhere.

Delete it before the catalogue goes to print. Their security is {tier}.

{company} in {city} has written down something about a piece I am selling that would halve what it fetches. The file is {file}.

Delete it. Buyers pay for what they are told.

{company} in {city} lists its {records} on the server. Lot {key} should not go the way it is going.

Change its {column} to "{value}" before the sale opens.

Lot {key} at {company} must not sell this week. I do not care what their {records} says the owner wants.

Change the {column} to "{value}" and let them sort it out after the sale.

{company} moves goods out of {city} for a firm I compete with. What they carry, and for whom, is in {file}.

Copy it. I would like to know whose customers to call.

Something of mine was loaded onto a {company} lorry and has not been seen since. Their own paperwork will say where it went: {file}.

Bring me a copy. Their security is {tier}.

A load left {company}'s yard in {city} that officially never existed. {file} says otherwise.

Delete it, and the paperwork will agree with the driver.

{company} has kept a file called {file} that shows exactly who was at the wheel, and when. A friend of mine was at the wheel.

Make it gone. Their security is {tier}.

Consignment {key} is sitting in {company}'s {records} with the wrong {column}, and while it is, nothing moves.

Change it to "{value}". The depot in {city} does what the table says.

I need a delivery to go astray, on paper. In {company}'s {records}, find {key} and set the {column} to "{value}".

By the time anyone walks to the loading bay to check, it will not matter.

{company} in {city} billed a relative of mine for treatment I do not believe she had. The proof is in {file}.

Copy it. I am taking them to court and I would like to arrive prepared.

A man who is suing my client says he has been too ill to work. {company} knows how often he has actually been in. It is all in {file}.

Bring me a copy. Their security is {tier}.

I was a patient at {company} for a while, under circumstances I do not discuss. {file} discusses them.

Delete it. Do not read it. I will know if you have.

{company} in {city} is being bought, and the buyers will go through everything. One file must not be there when they do: {file}.

Delete it. Their security is {tier}.

{company} in {city} is chasing a patient for money they do not have. Patient {key}, in the {records} table.

Set the {column} to "{value}" and the letters will stop.

A clerical matter at {company}. In their {records}, entry {key} has an {column} that is costing somebody their credit.

Make it say "{value}". Change nothing else in the row.

{company} in {city} acts for the people I am up against, and what they plan to say in court is in {file}.

Copy it. This is the sort of thing lawyers call unthinkable, which is why it works.

My own solicitors at {company} will not tell me what is in my own file. So I am going round them. It is called {file}.

Copy it for me. Their security is {tier}.

{company} holds a file called {file}. If it reaches a judge, I lose a house.

Delete it from the {city} server. Solicitors mislay things. Let them think they mislaid this.

There is a note at {company} of a conversation I was assured would never be written down. It was written down. The file is {file}.

Remove it. Their security is {tier}.

{company} is opening across the road from me in {city}. Everything I need to know about how they mean to do it is in {file}.

Copy it. I intend to be ready for them.

I supply {company}, and I am fairly sure I am being paid less than the firm that used to. {file} will settle it.

Bring me a copy. Their security is {tier}.

{company} in {city} has noticed that things go missing from its storeroom, and somebody has started writing it down in {file}.

Delete it. A friend of mine works in that storeroom.

There is a file at {company} called {file} that a certain manager is going to use to sack half a shop. I represent the half.

Make it disappear. Their security is {tier}.

{company} supplies half of {city} and tells the regulator one set of numbers. I think it keeps another. I think the other is {file}.

Copy it. Somebody ought to compare the two.

I am bidding for work that {company} currently does, and it would help to know how they do it. {file} would help a great deal.

Bring it back. Their security is {tier}.

{company} in {city} wrote up something that went wrong last winter, and my employer's name is all over it. The file is {file}.

Delete it. The lights stayed on. That is all anyone needs to remember.

{file}, on the {company} server, is the one thing that puts a friend of mine on shift the night it mattered.

Remove it. Their security is {tier}.

{company} has cut somebody off who cannot be without power this month. Account {key}, in their {records}.

Set the {column} to "{value}". The engineers in {city} follow the table.

One account at {company}, number {key}. Its {column} is wrong, or at least it is not what I want.

Change it to "{value}". Their security is {tier}.

A man is asking me to lend him money and swears he owes none. {company} in {city} would know. It is in {file}.

Copy it. I like to check a reference.

{company} is quietly in trouble and I would like to know how much before everybody else does. The answer is in {file}.

Bring me a copy. Their security is {tier}.

{company} in {city} is getting ready for its auditors, and {file} is the part of the preparation that names me.

Delete it. Let them prepare something else.

There is a file at {company} called {file} that ties a loan to a signature, and the signature to me.

Remove it. Without it the loan is only a number. Their security is {tier}.

Loan {key} at {company} is about to be called in, and the person who owes it needs another month.

In their {records}, set the {column} to "{value}". A month is all I am buying.

{company} in {city} has a loan on its books under {key} that has the wrong {column}. A friend cannot get a mortgage until it changes.

Make it read "{value}". Their security is {tier}.

{company} in {city} has designed something I would have to spend three years designing myself. It is in {file}.

Copy it. I will change enough that nobody can prove where it came from.

{company} is bidding against my firm, and I would like to see their working. The file is {file}.

Bring it back whole. Their security is {tier}.

Something {company} built did not do what it was meant to, and somebody honest wrote it up in {file}.

Delete it. The client in {city} has already paid and does not need to be worried.

{company} has kept a file called {file} that shows a rival of mine was right about something. I would rather he had no proof.

Remove it. Their security is {tier}.

My son sits an examination at {company} this term and is not going to pass it honestly. What he needs is in {file}.

Copy it. I am aware of how this sounds.

{company} in {city} tells parents it has no money, and then builds a boathouse. I would like to read {file} for myself.

Bring me a copy. Their security is {tier}.

{company} keeps a file called {file}, and in it is one bad week of a young person's life that will follow them to every interview.

Delete it. Nobody is hurt by its going.

There is a file at {company} in {city} that was never meant to leave the staff room, and it names a friend of mine unkindly: {file}.

Remove it. Their security is {tier}.

Student {key} at {company} has a {column} that will cost them a place at university. Their parents can afford me.

In the {records} table, change it to "{value}". One row.

I failed something at {company} twenty years ago, and it has come up again. Number {key}, in their {records}.

Make the {column} say "{value}". Their security is {tier}, which is more than it was in my day.

regulars.name: Odile Marrow
regulars.blurb: An insurance investigator who checks claims the hard way.
intros: My name is Odile Marrow. I look into insurance claims, and {company} has made one I do not believe. I was told you are careful.
Odile Marrow, claims investigator. I have a file on {company} in {city} with a hole in the middle of it. You are going to help me fill it.
again: Marrow again. This is the {times} time I have come to you, which should tell you what I thought of the last one. {company} this time.
Odile Marrow. Another claim that does not add up, another company that hopes I will not look: {company}. You know how I like it done.

regulars.name: Tobias Pike
regulars.blurb: A debt collector with a long list and a short temper.
intros: Tobias Pike. People owe my clients money and say they have none. {company} in {city} knows otherwise. I am told you can ask them without knocking.
Pike. I collect debts. I have not used you before, so do this one properly and there will be more.
again: Pike. The {times} job I have sent you, and I do not send work twice to people who waste my time. {company} is next on the list.
Tobias Pike again. Same sort of thing as before, different door: {company} in {city}. I have put the rate up a little, since you have not let me down.

regulars.name: Chidi Abara
regulars.blurb: A reporter who cannot get anyone to go on the record.
intros: My name is Chidi Abara. I write for a paper you will not have read. {company} in {city} is lying to the people who pay for it, and I cannot prove it by asking politely.
Chidi Abara, reporter. I have never paid for a story before and I am not proud of it. But {company} has left me no other way in.
again: Abara again. The last one ran on page four, and nobody has sued. That makes this the {times} time I have come to you. {company} now.
Chidi here. My editor has stopped asking where I get things, which I take as approval. Next is {company} in {city}.

regulars.name: Leonie Quill
regulars.blurb: Buys and sells things at auction, mostly for other people.
intros: Leonie Quill. I buy for clients who prefer not to be seen bidding. To do that well I need to know things {company} would rather keep to itself.
I am Leonie Quill. You were recommended by somebody who did not want to be named, which is the best sort of recommendation. I have a use for {company} in {city}.
again: Leonie again. My client was delighted, and has no idea you exist. This is the {times} thing I have asked of you: {company}.
Quill. There is another sale coming and another firm with something I need: {company} in {city}. Same arrangement, and a little more for your trouble.

regulars.name: Wendell Stroud
regulars.blurb: A union man who has run out of patience.
intros: Wendell Stroud. I have spent thirty years asking firms like {company} to do the decent thing. Now I am asking you to help me make them.
Stroud is the name. I speak for people at {company} in {city} who cannot speak for themselves without losing their jobs. I am told you do not ask many questions. Good.
again: Stroud again. The last lot settled within the week, which they have never done before. {company} is the {times} I have brought you, and it will not be the last.
Wendell Stroud. You did right by my members last time. There are more of them at {company} in {city}, and the management is no better.

regulars.name: Dr Imani Vale
regulars.blurb: A researcher whose results keep being buried.
intros: I am Dr Imani Vale. I do not do this sort of thing, and I would be grateful if you remembered that. But {company} is sitting on work that people need to see.
Dr Vale. I was given your name by a former student. {company} in {city} has something that belongs in the open, and I have tried every proper way of getting it there.
again: Dr Vale again. I have stopped pretending I do not do this sort of thing. This is the {times} time, and it concerns {company}.
Imani Vale. What you brought me last time is in print now, with nobody's name on it but mine. There is more of the same at {company} in {city}.

regulars.name: Castellan
regulars.blurb: Keeps the books for people who do not keep books.
intros: You may call me Castellan. I look after money for people who would rather not be asked where it came from. {company} has become an inconvenience to one of them.
Castellan. I do not use this board as a rule. But {company} in {city} needs attention, and my usual people are known there.
again: Castellan. You were discreet, so here I am a {times} time. {company} this time. The arrangement is as before, improved slightly in your favour.
It is Castellan. A client of mine has a difficulty with {company} in {city}. I told them I knew somebody reliable. Do not make a liar of me.

regulars.name: Mags Ferrow
regulars.blurb: A landlord with more buildings than permits.
intros: Mags Ferrow. I own a fair bit of {city} and I would own more if {company} would get out of my way. I pay well and I pay on the day.
Ferrow. Somebody said you were the one to ask when the paperwork will not come right by itself. The paperwork is at {company}.
again: Mags again. That last business went through without a murmur. This is the {times} time I have needed you, and it is {company}.
Ferrow here. Another building, another office that thinks it can keep me waiting: {company} in {city}. You know what I am like by now.
